text:
elaine: Quick heads up — PR #4721 is ready for a style + tone pass. Hoping to merge in today's docs merge window at 17:00 PT if we can get two approvals. Preview: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/pr-4721 (CI currently running)

nina: scanning now. main things I saw at a glance: inconsistent use of 'model endpoint' vs 'deployment'. We should standardize to 'deployment' in API docs, and 'endpoint' in quickstarts. can someone confirm? @sam

sam: agreed on that rule. Use 'deployment' for the platform concept, 'endpoint' for the URL/route. I'll add a one-line glossary note in the PR.

tyler: small nit: passive voice in the migration note "models are served" -> prefer "Redwood serves models". active voice reads better.

elaine: +1 on active voice. also watch for the phrase "production ready" — we use "production-grade" in product docs.

jen: FYI, docs-bot posted a preview build: \n```
[docs-bot] Preview for PR #4721: https://preview.builds.redwood.ai/4721
Status: building (10/28 jobs passed)
```

michael: I left inline suggestions for the SDK snippet formatting. Current Python example uses triple quotes for the request body and spans multiple lines; prefer a compact example for quickstarts.

nina: marking the following checklist in the PR comment:
- terminology ✅
- voice (active) ✅
- examples (compact SDK snippets) needs edits
- links (fix 2 broken anchor links) needs edits
- CI/docs preview ✅ (build ok)

sam: pushed an update to the Python snippet. New version:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-alpha", prompt="Summarize this input.")
print(resp.text)
```
short and copy-paste friendly.

elaine: thanks. nina, would you re-check the examples section when you get a sec? this is the blocker for approvals.

nina: re-reviewing now. Found one more link fix: the migration guide anchor changed from `#v1-to-v2` to `#migrate-v1-v2`. pushed a tiny fix.

docs-bot: \n```
[CI] All checks passed for PR #4721 — 0 unresolved comments
[Deploy] Preview available: https://preview.builds.redwood.ai/4721
```

tyler: looks good from my side. one more micro-nit: replace "we" with "Redwood" in public-facing docs where possible.

elaine: ok we have two +1s (tyler, sam) and nina sign-off pending final snippet check.

nina: done. snippet looks good, links fixed, voice edits applied. approving now.

sam: approving as well. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks all. merging in the 17:00 PT merge window.

docs-bot: \n```
[Merge] PR #4721 merged by elaine at 17:03 PT
[Publish] Docs site publishing started.
```

michael: thanks — will spot-check the site once publish completes.

docs-bot: \n```
[Publish] Complete: https://docs.redwood.ai/serve/inference
```

elaine: great work, team. small follow-up: i'll file a short ADR to codify "deployment vs endpoint" wording so this doesn't keep popping up. :memo:

sam: thanks, that ADR will be helpful.

jen: leaving a note in the docs handbook about the merge window and review expectations.

elaine: done — closing thread. :tada:
